targeted_result.unfixed_reason: The focus clause ends in a connective, so the sentence-final finite-assertion heuristic did not recognize the local descriptive event.

failure_diagnosis.primary: V55 over-localized operator scope instead of representing syntactic relations between clauses.
failure_diagnosis.request_regression_reason: FINITE_ASSERTION_RE can match an early ta/da sequence and absorb up to eight trailing characters, so valid directives such as kudasai and coordinated te-forms were reclassified as mentions.
failure_diagnosis.conditional_regression_reason: The hypothetical marker was outside the target clause but governed its consequent; same-clause-only binding incorrectly turned the consequent into an immediate request.
missing_relation_types: directive morphology must outrank generic finite-assertion evidence
a final directive may share force with coordinated preceding actions
a conditional antecedent may govern a target in its consequent
